title: does not remove a live owner published after stale-owner inspection
invariant: Cleanup cannot unlink a replacement owner's lock.

title: marks an ambiguous spawn timeout uncertain and never retries it
invariant: Unknown spawn outcome cannot authorize another dispatch.

title: replays terminal evidence that arrives before the spawn reply binds the agent
invariant: Early terminal evidence settles only the matching dispatch.

title: supersession: an older in-flight same-key wake cannot deliver after a newer wake queues while idle
invariant: Older in-flight work cannot displace current pending instructions.

title: RA-06: starts monitor shutdown before awaiting orchestration shutdown
invariant: Monitor fencing starts before awaited teardown can yield.

title: acknowledges durable orchestration wake state only after message delivery
invariant: Acknowledgement follows the tested send boundary, not queue admission.

title: does not convert all-%s discovery to a dry success
invariant: Failed or skipped mandatory discovery is incomplete, not negative evidence.

title: stops novel findings at the %s boundary
invariant: New findings cannot renew campaign call or repair limits.
